name: AI limits
author: ismoil
description: Usage limits of the AI tools on this machine — Claude, Codex, Gemini — in the bar, with a switch between them, plain-language verdicts, pace meters and forecasts. Readable for low vision (text scaling, WCAG AA contrast), English and Russian.

barWidget.description: Claude, Codex and Gemini limits in the bar; popup with every window, pace and forecast

schema.label: AIs to show: all, or a list such as claude,codex,gemini
schema.description: Only tools that are signed in on this machine appear. The order in the popup is Claude, Codex, Gemini.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: auto follows the system locale (Russian or English).

schema.label: Text size
schema.description: Scales the popup text and the bar text. Text is never smaller than 13 px.

schema.label: Active hours: from (0-23)
schema.description: The week's pace is counted over the hours you actually use AI tools. 0-23; invalid values fall back to 8-23.

schema.label: Active hours: to (1-24)
schema.description: Must be later than the start; 0 to 24 is round the clock.

schema.label: Animations
schema.description: Turn off to stop the meters from sliding.

schema.label: Renew the Claude login when it expires
schema.description: Off by default. When on, an expired token is renewed the way Claude Code does it and written back to ~/.claude/.credentials.json. When off, the widget waits until you run claude.
